entities.summary: Drew Pearson is an American former professional football player who was a wide receiver for 11 seasons with the Dallas Cowboys of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Tulsa Golden Hurricane. He was inducted into the Pro Football Hall of Fame in 2021.
